semantics.mutation_rule: constructs a new unloaded native model; verified state loading and train or eval mode mutate only that model instance
semantics.alias_rule: fresh native module tree and state schema with no shared mutable parameter storage
semantics.shape_rule: constructs the torchvision 0.27 EfficientNet-V2-S six-stage 40-block architecture with 1000 classifier outputs
semantics.dtype_rule: state schema requires canonical F32 parameters and buffers
semantics.accumulation_dtype: F32 native convolution, normalization, activation, pooling, and classifier execution
semantics.layout_rule: eval-only model forward accepts logical contiguous NCHW F32 images and publishes contiguous native tensors
semantics.device_rule: constructor is device-neutral; loaded model execution uses the native CPU backend and rejects unsupported placement typed
semantics.numeric_rule: torchvision 0.27 reviewed-source EfficientNet-V2-S architecture, 21,458,488 parameters, atomic verified state loading, deterministic eval-only inference, and no external runtime
semantics.tolerance: 1e-4 absolute and relative for finite inference fixtures
semantics.determinism: fixed module registration and execution order; deterministic native kernels in eval mode
semantics.cancellation_points: during schema construction, verified state loading, at native module boundaries, and before output publication
semantics.vjp_rule: forward-only at the two cataloged Stable Cascade feature-extractor inference call sites
